translations.text: The word of the Lord that came to Zephaniah son of Cushi, son of Gedaliah, son of Amariah, son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah son of Amon, king of Judah.
Let them utterly fail and vanish from the face of the earth, says the Lord.
Let man and beast vanish; let the birds of the sky and the fish of the sea vanish; and let the ungodly be weakened. And I will remove the lawless from the face of the earth, says the Lord.
And I will stretch out my hand against Judah and against all the inhabitants of Jerusalem. And I will remove from this place the names of Baal and the names of the priests,
and those who worship the hosts of heaven on the rooftops, and those who swear by the Lord and those who swear by their king,
and those who have turned away from the Lord, and those who do not seek the Lord, and those who do not hold fast to the Lord.
Be afraid before the face of the Lord God, for the day of the Lord is near. The Lord has prepared his sacrifice; he has sanctified his chosen ones.
And on that day of the Lord's sacrifice I will take vengeance on the rulers and on the king's house, and on all who have put on foreign clothing.
And on that day I will openly take vengeance before the gates on all who fill the house of their God with ungodliness and deceit.
And on that day, says the Lord, there will be a sound of crying from the gates of the pierced, and wailing from the second quarter, and great destruction from the hills.
Wail, you who live in the place of the slain, for the whole people has become like Canaan; all who were raised high by silver have been destroyed.
And on that day I will search Jerusalem with a lamp, and I will take vengeance on the men who scorn their charges [?], who say in their hearts: "The Lord will do neither good nor evil."
Their wealth will be plundered and their houses destroyed. They will build houses and not live in them, and they will plant vineyards and not drink their wine.
For the day of the Lord is near, near and coming very quickly. The sound of the day of the Lord is bitter and harsh; it is set, and it is mighty.
That day is a day of wrath: a day of distress and anguish, a day of misery and ruin, a day of gloom and darkness, a day of cloud and mist,
a day of the trumpet and of the battle cry against the strong cities and against the high corner towers.

And I will bring distress on people, and they will walk like the blind, because they have sinned against the Lord. Their blood will be poured out like dust, their blood will be poured out on the ground, and their flesh will be like dung.

And their silver and their gold will not be able to save them on the day of the Lord's wrath. And the whole earth will be consumed by the fire of his jealousy, for he will bring a swift end on all the inhabitants of the earth.
Gather together and assemble yourselves, you undisciplined nation, before you become
like flowers that pass away, your days, before the wrath of the Lord comes upon you, before the day of the wrath of the Lord's anger comes upon you.
Seek the Lord, all you humble of the earth. Do justice and seek righteousness, and speak uprightly, so that you may be sheltered on that day of the Lord's wrath.
For Gaza will be plundered and Ashkelon destroyed, Ashdod will be driven out at noon, and Ekron will be uprooted.
Woe to those who dwell in the regions of the sea, sojourners of the Cretans! The word of the Lord is against you, Canaan, land of the foreigners, and I will destroy you from your dwelling place.
And Crete shall be a pasture for flocks and a fold for sheep.

And that region of the sea shall belong to the remnant of the house of Judah. They shall graze on it; in the houses of Ashkelon they shall hide at evening from the face of the sons of Judah, for the Lord God will visit them and bring back their captives.
I have heard the taunts of Moab and the insults of the sons of Ammon, with which they taunted my people and made themselves great against my borders.

Therefore thus says the Lord: As I live, said the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, Moab shall be like Sodom, and the sons of Ammon like Gomorrah, and Damascus abandoned like a heap on a threshing floor, and they are destroyed forever. And the remnant of my people shall plunder them, and the remnant of my people shall take possession of them.
This shall come upon them in return for their insolence, for they taunted the Lord Almighty and made themselves great against him.
The Lord shall appear against them, and he will destroy all the gods of the nations of the earth, and they shall worship him alone, each from his own place, all the islands of the nations.
And you Ethiopians shall be among the wounded of my sword.
And he will stretch out his hand toward the north and destroy the Assyrian, and he will make Nineveh a ruin, waterless like a desert.

And flocks shall graze in its midst, and all the beasts of the earth, and chameleons and hedgehogs shall lodge in its paneled ceilings, and beasts shall cry out in their ravines, and ravens at its gates; for its height was like a cedar.

This is the scornful city that dwelt in confidence, which said in its heart, 'I am, and there is no one else after me.' How it has become a ruin, a pasture for beasts! Everyone who passes through it will hiss and shake his hands.
O renowned and redeemed city, the dove! It did not listen to the voice nor accept instruction; it did not trust in the Lord, and did not draw near to its God.
Its princes within it are like roaring lions; its judges are like the wolves of Arabia; they left nothing until morning.
Its prophets are spirit-bearing men, men of contempt. Its priests profane what is holy and act impiously against the law.

But the Lord is righteous in its midst, and he will not do falsehood. At dawn he will bring his judgment to light, and it will not be hidden; and he did not know falsehood in his dealings, and did not let falsehood prevail.

I brought the proud down to destruction; their corner towers were ruined. I will make their roads utterly desolate, so that no one walks on them. Their cities have been emptied, because there is no one to live in them.
I said: 'But fear me and accept instruction, and all that I have avenged on it will not be cut off from its eyes.' Make ready, rise early, for all their grape clusters have been ruined.

Therefore wait for me, says the Lord, for the day of my rising up as a witness. For my judgment is upon the assembly of the nations, to bring in kings, to pour out my wrath on them, all the wrath of my anger. For the whole earth shall be consumed by the fire of my jealousy.
For then I will turn the peoples' tongues toward their own kind, so that all of them may call upon the name of the Lord and serve him under one yoke.
From the far ends of the river of India I will receive them among my scattered people; they will bring me my sacrifices.

On that day you will not be ashamed of all your deeds, the ungodliness you committed against me. For then I will take away from you the falsehood of your insolence, and you will no longer be haughty on my holy mountain.
And I will leave in your midst a meek and humble people, and they will fear the name of the Lord:
the remnant of Israel. They will not do falsehood or speak what is empty, and no deceitful tongue will be found in their mouth. For they will graze and lie down, and no one will make them afraid.
Rejoice, daughter of Zion; proclaim it, Jerusalem. Rejoice and be glad with all your heart, daughter of Jerusalem.
For the Lord has taken away your falsehoods. He has rescued you from the hands of your enemies. The King of Israel, the Lord, is in your midst. From now on you will no longer see evil.
At that time the Lord will say to Jerusalem: "Do not be afraid, Zion; do not let your hands grow weak."
The Lord your God is in your midst. The Mighty One will save you. He will bring gladness upon you and renew you in his love, and he will rejoice over you with gladness, as on a feast day.
And I will gather those who were crushed. Woe to the one who brought reproach upon her!

For behold, at that time I will act in your midst for your sake. I will save the one who is oppressed and take in the one who was driven away, and I will make them a source of pride and renown in all the earth.

And they will be ashamed at that time, when I do good to you and when I receive you. For I will make you renowned and a source of pride among all the peoples of the earth when I bring back your captives before your eyes, says the Lord.
